#Module scripts

Script loading, the event loop and JavaScript workers as the engine needs them (HTML "scripting"): document.write / open / close, the script element's own state, Content-Security-Policy checks of inline code and of eval, ES module graphs (the browser fetches a whole graph, the engine links and runs it), unhandled promise rejections, javascript: URLs, workers whose script is JavaScript and their structured-clone messages. Implemented in src/page/js_load*.odin and js_workers.odin; used by native/js/runtime (load.c, modules.c, handlers.c, load_errors.c, timers.c, workers.c).

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/js_load.widl.

#Functions

#Document_writeMarkup

void Document_writeMarkup(usvstring markup) raises

document.write(markup) (writeln adds the newline): inserted at the parser's insertion point while the document loads (scripts written run before it returns), else the document is opened again first and replaced. Invalid_State for a document that does not accept it now (a custom element constructor, a parser that would have to be aborted).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Document_writeMarkup :: proc(c: ^Call, markup: string) -> Api_Error

#Document_openStream

void Document_openStream() raises

document.open(): the document is emptied and its parser starts again (does nothing while the parser runs a script; the listeners and handlers of its tree and of its Window are erased, the engine's records first through its export wj_document_opening). Invalid_State when the document cannot be opened.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Document_openStream :: proc(c: ^Call) -> Api_Error

#Document_closeStream

void Document_closeStream() raises

document.close(): the parser of a document.open() finishes (DOMContentLoaded, then load).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Document_closeStream :: proc(c: ^Call) -> Api_Error

#HTMLScriptElement_forceAsync

bool HTMLScriptElement_forceAsync(u64 element)

The "force async" flag of a script element (set when a script creates it: dynamic scripts are async unless their async attribute is set to false).

Host: HTMLScriptElement_forceAsync :: proc(c: ^Call, element: u64) -> bool

#HTMLScriptElement_setForceAsync

void HTMLScriptElement_setForceAsync(u64 element, bool value)

script.async = value: the attribute is set or removed by the caller, this clears the flag.

Host: HTMLScriptElement_setForceAsync :: proc(c: ^Call, element: u64, value: bool)

#Script_allowInline

bool Script_allowInline(u64 element, InlineScriptKind kind, usvstring source)

May this inline code run (Content-Security-Policy: 'unsafe-inline', nonces, hashes)? A refusal is reported as a violation. element is the element it comes from (0 for a javascript: URL).

Host: Script_allowInline :: proc(c: ^Call, element: u64, kind: Api_InlineScriptKind, source: string) -> bool

#Script_allowEval

bool Script_allowEval(usvstring source)

May eval() / new Function / setTimeout(string) compile this ('unsafe-eval')? A refusal is reported.

Host: Script_allowEval :: proc(c: ^Call, source: string) -> bool

#Script_javascriptResult

void Script_javascriptResult(usvstring html)

The result of a javascript: URL that was a string: it becomes the document (HTML "navigate to a javascript: URL").

Host: Script_javascriptResult :: proc(c: ^Call, html: string)

#Script_baseName

string Script_baseName()

The URL naming code that has no script of its own in stack traces and as the base of import() (handlers, timer strings): the document's (the worker's script in a worker).

Host: Script_baseName :: proc(c: ^Call) -> string

#Module_resolve

string Module_resolve(usvstring specifier, usvstring base) raises

The URL a module specifier stands for, imported from the module (or script) at base ("" for the root of a graph, given as a URL already): import maps, then URL parsing. Type: a bare specifier nothing maps, or not a URL.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Module_resolve :: proc(c: ^Call, specifier: string, base: string) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Module_source

string Module_source(usvstring url) raises

The source of a module of the page's module map. Not_Found when the browser does not have it.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Module_source :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Module_request

void Module_request(usvstring module_url, usvstring specifier, ModuleType type) raises

The module at module_url imports specifier: resolved and fetched if new (part of the module's graph).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Module_request :: proc(c: ^Call, module_url: string, specifier: string, type: Api_ModuleType) -> Api_Error

#Module_import

void Module_import(i32 id, usvstring specifier, usvstring base, ModuleType type) raises

import(specifier) from code at base: the browser fetches the graph, then calls the engine's wj_module_import_done(id, ...) from a task of its own. Type: the specifier cannot be resolved.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Module_import :: proc(c: ^Call, id: i32, specifier: string, base: string, type: Api_ModuleType) -> Api_Error

#Engine_queueRejectionCheck

void Engine_queueRejectionCheck()

Unhandled promise rejections are waiting: run the engine's wj_notify_rejections in a task of its own.

Host: Engine_queueRejectionCheck :: proc(c: ^Call)

#Worker_createScript

u64 Worker_createScript(usvstring url, usvstring name, WorkerType type) raises

new Worker(url, {name, type}) for a JavaScript worker: the Worker object (a handle of module workers). Syntax for an invalid URL, Not_Allowed when the browser refuses (the console says why).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Worker_createScript :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, name: string, type: Api_WorkerType) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Worker_postSerialized

void Worker_postSerialized(u64 worker, bytes data) raises

worker.postMessage(message): the message as structured serialization bytes (native/js/runtime/clone.c).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Worker_postSerialized :: proc(c: ^Call, worker: u64, data: []u8) -> Api_Error

#DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope_postSerialized

void DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope_postSerialized(bytes data) raises

postMessage(message) in a JavaScript worker.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope_postSerialized :: proc(c: ^Call, data: []u8) -> Api_Error

#WorkerGlobalScope_importScript

string WorkerGlobalScope_importScript(usvstring url) raises

importScripts(url), one URL: fetched synchronously (same rules as the worker's script). The result is the response's URL, a NUL byte, then the script. Network when it cannot be fetched or is not JavaScript; Type in a module worker (importScripts is a classic worker's).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: WorkerGlobalScope_importScript :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string) -> (string, Api_Error)

#WorkerGlobalScope_isModule

bool WorkerGlobalScope_isModule()

Whether the calling worker's script is a module ({type: "module"}).

Host: WorkerGlobalScope_isModule :: proc(c: ^Call) -> bool

#SharedWorker_connect

u64 SharedWorker_connect(usvstring url, usvstring name, WorkerType type, bool extended_lifetime) raises

new SharedWorker(url, {name, type, extendedLifetime}) from a document: the SharedWorker object (it gets error events), connected to the shared worker of (the document's storage key, the URL, the name), which starts if none runs. Its port: SharedWorker_portEnd. Syntax for an invalid URL, Security for a URL of another origin, Not_Allowed when the browser refuses (shared workers disabled, too many: the console says why).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: SharedWorker_connect :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, name: string, type: Api_WorkerType, extended_lifetime: bool) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Worker_createScriptBytes

u64 Worker_createScriptBytes(usvstring url, usvstring name, WorkerType type, bytes script) raises

new Worker(blobURL) / new SharedWorker(blobURL): the same, with the script the engine read from the Blob the URL stands for (blob: URLs live in the realm that made them, the browser cannot fetch them).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Worker_createScriptBytes :: proc(c: ^Call, url: string, name: string, type: Api_WorkerType, script: []u8) -> (u64, Api_Error)

string Worker_pendingError()

While wj_worker_error_to_global runs: the worker's uncaught error that its Worker object's error event did not cancel, "message TAB filename" (HTML: it is reported in the owner's global, window.onerror).

Host: Worker_pendingError :: proc(c: ^Call) -> string
